flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4174/app?demo then Open Settings with the gear button at the bottom of the sidebar.
Check that t1dem/proofed-demo-store shows "Opus 5.5 · high".
Open that menu and choose Sonnet 5.5.
Check that the button for t1dem/proofed-demo-store now reads "Sonnet 5.5 · high" and t1dem/proofed still shows "Haiku 5.5 · xhigh".

Do each step once, the way it is described. If a click or a key press does something other than what the step expects, the check fails: don't retry it, and don't reach the goal another way (other buttons, links, keyboard shortcuts, typing the URL). Waiting for a slow page to load is fine.
